requiredFindings.title: Endpoint admission omits the C.store comparison
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The marker and the node admit (S, G, K), and C.store on the trust current record holds a different S, G or K. SelectedStoreEndpoint is still granted because item 1 never compares C.store's three fields with the admitted triple. A later binder treats that triple as the store owner §7 admitted. F27's join against C.store is never made, and no later unit is assigned the comparison.

requiredFindings.title: The rewrite recheck names subject changed
requiredFindings.failureScenario: An in-place rewrite of a retained endpoint file updates ctime. The full-sample recheck returns CustodyRefusal::Changed. gate_refusal publishes CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED subject required-files-changed. An implementer who follows item 2 emits subject changed. The same rewrite is pinned to two subjects.

requiredFindings.title: Structural refusals use the doctor finding subjects
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A broken chain or a duplicate-key disagreement becomes GateRefusal::Incomplete. Item 5 requires subject installation-incomplete:chain. The host projection of InstallationTermination::Incomplete publishes installation-incomplete, which is 468 item 6 and 458c item 7. A host left on that subject fails the law's tests. A host changed to the colon subject moves every non-doctor incomplete read off 458c item 7, and a writer termination carries a doctor finding subject.

requiredFindings.title: A coreClosure mismatch is routed as a core refusal
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The receipt's core admitted, and the selection pair names another coreClosure. Item 5 publishes EXTENSION.ADMISSION_REJECTED / NT-TCB-IDENTITY subject selected-core-mismatch. Callers treat NT-TCB-IDENTITY as a failed core admission. The contradictory installation leaves the incomplete row that 468 item 6 and 458c item 7 assign to wrong owner-chain linkage.
